Extension of Last date for submission of comments from stakeholders on the 'Draft 
Telecommunication (Broadcasting & Cable) Services DRM Based Digital 
Addressable Systems Audit Manual, 2026' 
New Delhi, 30th October 2026 - The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has 
released the 'Draft Telecommunication (Broadcasting & Cable) Services DRM Based 
Digital Addressable Systems Audit Manual' (hereinafter referred to as 'Draft DRM Audit 
Manual') for seeking comments of stakeholders' on 9t1 October 2026. The last date for 
submission of comments on the 'Draft DRM Audit Manual' by the stakeholders was fixed 
as 30t October 2026. 
2. In view of the requests received from stakeholders for extension of time for 
submission of comments, on the ground that the subject matter under consideration 
involves complex technical, operational and regulatory dimensions and required 
detailed examination, it has been decided to extend the last dates for submission of 
written comments by 13th November 2026. No further requests for extension would be 
considered. 
3. The comments may be sent, preferably in electronic form at adibcs2@trkgpJn 
and jtadbc&3SraLgcwdn. For any clarification/information, Dr. Deepati Sharma, 
Advisor (B&CS), maybe contacted at Tel. No.: +91-11-20907774. 
(Harinder Kumar) 
Secretary, TRAI
